correctness.rationale: PASS. Direct normalized Szegő-kernel summation gives ber(T)=sup_{0<=r<1}r|a+br²|/(1+r²). The operator norm is max(|a|,|b|); a gauged positive half-line Jacobi matrix with alternating weights has numerical radius (|a|+|b|)/2 by row-sum upper bound and long blocks. For |a|>=|b| the r=1/2 witness is strictly stronger; for |b|>=|a| the r=sqrt(2)-1 and boundary r->1 witnesses have envelopes meeting uniquely at a/b=-(4sqrt(2)-5). Differentiating the extremal radial profile confirms both constants, the unique equality family and the fully attained Berezin disk via interior r=sqrt(2)-1. Independently tested 6006 complex coefficient phases and 1500 radial sample points; finite grids corroborate but do not prove infinite-dimensional sharpness.
residual_risks: Kernel sup includes a nonattained boundary limit in intermediate estimates; actual extremal circle is attained at an interior radius.
